difficulty_reason: Allow standard type-B root data, the PBW theorem, Weyl dimension formula, the spin realization and Molev's Gelfand--Tsetlin parametrization. The author still constructs the weighted Dyck/Gelfand--Tsetlin bijection and proves ordered-monomial straightening through nine exterior-power cases with short-root commutator corrections. A new antichain Minkowski lemma and tensor-product leading-term induction establish the stronger ordered reduction for arbitrary dominant weights, after which the arranged-monomial basis theorem follows. These explicit source-local constructions exceed routine qualifying-exam representation theory, so H3 is proposed subject to root final material and global semantic review.
